config.maximum-fish.name: Maximum fish
config.maximum-fish.tooltip: Upper limit for how many fish can be in the water at once. Lower it if the mod costs too much performance. Default: 500
config.fish-density.name: Fish density
config.fish-density.tooltip: Fish per water tile, so 0.1 means every 10th tile gets a fish. Still limited by Maximum fish. Default: 0.2
config.show-treasure.name: Show treasure in the water
config.show-treasure.tooltip: Show paintings, furniture and other non-fish treasures that can be fished here.
config.trash-outside.name: Trash outside the farm
config.trash-farm.name: Trash on the farm
config.disable-trash-lvl10.name: Hide junk at fishing level 10
config.disable-trash-lvl10.tooltip: Stop showing junk items (trash, driftwood, soggy newspaper...) once your fishing level is 10. Seaweed and algae are still shown.
config.draw-item-shadows.name: Draw shadows under items
config.draw-fish-shadows.name: Draw shadows under fish
config.rotate-algae.name: Rotate algae and seaweed
config.filter-eels.name: Hide eel-like fish
